feature_flags.name: turnover_verification_alerting
feature_flags.required_state: already ON and staying on - this release does not gate anything, it narrows when the existing alert fires. Before: any day without a cleaning session alerted, including days with no guest checkout. After: only a day where a confirmed guest stay ended can alert. The turnover-verifier edge function carrying the matching guard was deployed 2026-09-10 ~06:10Z and is inert until this migration lands.

compatibility.evidence: Same signature and same return shape; one new early return adds the issue code 'no_checkout_scheduled' with check_passed true. The only caller, turnover-verifier pass 1, is updated in the same change to skip alerting on that code; pass 2 already gates on check_passed and needs no change. The migration asserts all three live cases inside the apply transaction, so a wrong result rolls back.

stop_conditions: the turnover-verifier edge function is ALREADY DEPLOYED with the guard (2026-09-10 ~06:10Z); until this migration lands the guard is inert because the database never emits no_checkout_scheduled, so behaviour is unchanged and the false alarms continue
any assertion in the migration's DO block raises - in particular, 2026-09-07 must still fail as a real missed turnover
any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the turnover-verifier edge function must be deployed in the same window, or the false alarms continue despite the fix
